name: MiniCzechBenchmark
description: MiniCzechBenchmark is a contamination-resistant, lightweight evaluation framework for rapid large language model assessment in Czech, maintaining high statistical validity while reducing computational requirements significantly.
reputation: A lightweight Czech benchmark designed for fast, contamination-resistant evaluation and useful for rapid local LLM comparison, though it is not yet a broadly standardized community benchmark.
notes: Focuses on Czech language evaluation with over 50 models tested, revealing performance gaps between English and Czech capabilities.
